form.clientIdHelp: Usually AppId or ClientID, subject to the actual platform name
form.clientSecretHelp: Usually AppSecret or ClientSecret, subject to the actual platform name
form.callbackUrlHelp: Register these URLs in the third-party OAuth console; admin and merchant each need a full set
form.callbackUrlEmpty: Please set the admin access URL in the endpoint configuration first
form.callbackUrlEmptyAdmin: Please set Admin Base URL in endpoint configuration first
form.callbackUrlEmptyMerchant: Please set Merchant Base URL (merchantBaseUrl) in endpoint configuration; required for merchant social login
form.gatewayWeChatHint: Fill {domain} (without protocol) in the WeChat Official Account web authorization domain; login and bind callbacks transit via the gateway back to this system
form.gatewayAlipayHint: Fill {domain} (full address with protocol) in the authorization callback address of the Alipay open-platform app, and enable domain-level validation on the same page; login and bind callbacks transit via the gateway back to this system
form.gatewayUrlNotConfigured: Set the payment gateway frontend URL (paymentGatewayBaseUrl) in endpoint config first; platform-redirect login callbacks transit via the gateway domain
form.gatewayRegisterHelp: Platform-redirect sources (Alipay / WeChat Official Account) transit login and bind callbacks via the gateway domain; only the gateway domain needs to be registered on the open platform

confirm.delete: Are you sure to delete the {name} configuration?

tip.platformCredentialRequired: Please complete platform-level credentials before enabling login

platformCredentialHint.alipay: Manage AppId/keys in Alipay App Config; this switch only controls whether Alipay login is available
platformCredentialHint.weChat: Manage AppId/keys in WeChat Official Account Config; this switch only controls whether WeChat login is available
